sentences.text:
This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.134 of 2023, under
Sections 498A, 304B, 34 I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Kotwali Kalpi, District Jalaun
with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is husband of deceased.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place on 02.07.2017.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been leveled against all the accused persons.

It was stated that the deceased was pressurizing applicant to live separately from the family members of the applicant and when Pawan vs State Of U.P. Through Home Secretary, ... on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20790744/
1 applicant refused, she has committed suicide by hanging.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death has been shown asphyxia as a result of ante-mortem hanging.
It is further submitted that the co-accused Ramkishun and Smt. Rajkumari, who are father-in-law and mother-in-law of deceased, have already been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 16.05.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances, within a period of seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Pawan involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii.
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 6.1.2025 RKM  Pawan vs State Of U.P. Through Home Secretary, ... on 6 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20790744/
